title: Raspberry Pi 5
prompt: a Raspberry Pi 5 board: insert the microSD card, plug in power, it boots and the activity LED blinks, plug in HDMI; see-through labels the SoC, RAM, RP1 I/O chip, PMIC, USB and Ethernet ports, GPIO header
blurb: Slide in the microSD card and plug in power to watch a Raspberry Pi 5 boot step by step, from the PMIC's power rails through the boot EEPROM, RAM and SD card to Linux waking the RP1 I/O chip.
